items.title: IV of Spades takes top Awit Award nods
items.description: THE four-piece band IV of Spades took home the top prizes — Song of the Year for “Aura” and Album of the Year for Andalucia — at this year’s Awit Awards which were held on Sept. 15 at the SM Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City. Another track, “Monster,” won Best Sound Engineer Recording.
